scope: Independent source and contract review only. No runtime, browser, build, test, inventory, or source changes.

verdicts.A_procedure_accuracy_executability: ADDRESSED. All four original procedure defects are corrected in the proposal. The procedures remain not_executable where required fixtures or exact cleanup proof are absent; no runtime success is claimed.
verdicts.B_provenance_limits: ADDRESSED. Existing case/control IDs, modes, and dimensions are retained. Source-derived/manual-handler evidence is separated from runtime behavior and dispatcher permissions; permission dimensions remain explicitly unverified. No executable fixture is invented.

findings.source_proof: ToolsView initializes surface to canonical (src/features/tools/ToolsView.tsx:125) and filters internal handlers from that view (:142); file_upload is an internal form action, while upload_file is canonical (src/lib/tools/categories.ts:459-480; src/lib/tools/handlers/forms.ts:408-470). The revised step switches to Internal or All before searching. The local form-controls fixture has no file input (tests/browser/fixtures/form-controls.html).
findings.executability: Correctly remains not_executable until an owned file-input fixture with observable events and reset exists. The synthetic base64 payload decodes to the asserted 26 bytes.

findings.source_proof: upload_file requires tab_id/ref/file_ids, activates the tab, and rejects a missing/non-file input before setting files (src/lib/tools/handlers/canonical.ts:812-867). The revised proposal requires an existing exact owned MediaRef and cleanup path; it does not claim the handler creates one.
findings.executability: Correctly remains not_executable without the owned ref fixture, known MediaRef, and verified exact-ID cleanup.

findings.source_proof: drop_file returns No drop target only when the selector/coordinate resolves to a non-HTMLElement; any present HTMLElement receives synthetic events and yields ok:true without listener-acceptance checking (src/lib/tools/handlers/canonical.ts:923-954). Revised negative branch uses a run-unique ref verified absent from the fixture DOM and expects no-target refusal.
findings.executability: Correctly remains not_executable pending an event-observing drop-zone fixture, owned MediaRef, and exact cleanup path.

findings.source_proof: The tab_id path uploads before extraction; its catch returns only an error, while successful output includes file_id (src/lib/tools/handlers/canonical.ts:983-1029; upload route src/lib/api/routes/files.ts:109-167). Revised procedure requires at least three pages, limits each role/build to one ingestion, uses its returned file_id for page-range and past-last-page calls, and blocks ingestion until independent owner-scoped enumeration and exact cleanup include failure cases.
findings.executability: Correctly remains not_executable absent a qualifying PDF fixture and demonstrated enumeration/cleanup route. Range refusal remains explicitly unverified.

findings.source_proof: ToolsView's manual Run path directly calls handler.run with permissionMode act (src/features/tools/ToolsView.tsx:453-463), bypassing normal dispatcher authorization. The revised proposal retains original dimensions and adds permission_dimension_status=unverified for each case; member/admin manual runs do not receive permission credit. Inventory case/control/mode/dimension metadata matches the original entries in docs/stabilization/inventory.json.

limits: No browser/backend execution, runtime outcome, role result, permission result, upload enumeration, or cleanup was observed.
The source procedure cannot establish whether the required external fixture or exact cleanup capability exists at run time; the proposal correctly makes those explicit prerequisites.
